package main

import (
	"flag"
	"testing"
)

var ownerRecursive = flag.Bool("owner-recursive", false, "review-derived recursive default")

func TestPinnedOwnerPaths(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	c := defaultConfig(t.TempDir())
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		path string
		want bool
	}{{".spectackle/spec/spec.md", true}, {"autograd/.spectackle/work/entry.ndjson", *ownerRecursive}, {"pkg/deep/.spectackle/journal/record.md", *ownerRecursive}, {"pkg/.spectackle-adjacent/readme.md", false}, {"pkg/README.md", false}, {"pkg/code.go", false}, {"pkg/assets/model.bin", false}, {"pkg/native/kernel.c", false}, {"docs/guide.md", true}} {
		t.Run(tc.path, func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Parallel()
			_, got := c.ignoredBy(tc.path)
			if got != tc.want {
				t.Errorf("ignoredBy(%q)=%t,want%t", tc.path, got, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
	if _, full := c.fullRerunBy(".github/workflows/ci.yml"); !full {
		t.Fatal("full-rerun policy lost")
	}
}
